svg.aria-label: A pyramid of crabs on a sandy shore at dusk. 4 crabs on the sand hold up the products 2, 6, 3 and 4. On a rock above them, 2 crabs hold the sums of pairs, 8 and 7. On the highest rock, 1 crab holds the total, 15. A tag reads: pairs, then pairs of pairs.
